name: ots-explain
description: Explain an OpenTimestamps proof hop by hop: static page + stdlib Python script that must agree.

scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:py && npm run test:browser
scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage 'test/js/*.test.mjs' && coverage run --rcfile=.coveragerc -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_*.py' && coverage report --rcfile=.coveragerc
